high_impact_watchlist.topic: Geopolitical de-escalation or escalation headlines (ceasefire, sanctions, strikes)
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Safe-haven premium is added or unwound quickly with no data lag
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Official confirmation from governments/state media rather than unnamed-source reports

high_impact_watchlist.topic: Central bank gold demand and official reserve updates
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Structural bid underpins dips; slowdown removes a key support pillar after a parabolic advance
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Monthly reserve reports or credible reports of pause/acceleration in official buying

high_impact_watchlist.topic: ETF flows, CME margin changes and positioning liquidation

high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Exchange margin notices or multi-session outflow streaks in major gold ETFs

high_impact_watchlist.topic: Treasury supply/auction demand and TGA-driven liquidity

high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Notable tails, weak bid-to-cover, or high indirect/dealer takedown

high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Systemic stress triggers flight-to-quality bids and prices in emergency easing
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Named institution stress, spiking funding spreads, or emergency facility usage

ranked_data_influence.verdict: Price movement is the final arbiter for whether the prior thesis transmitted.
Fresh catalysts matter when source, freshness, and transmission mechanism are clear.
RSI/MAs/candle momentum are now scored as a normalized tensor for entry timing and confirmation.
Dollar moves usually matter when the intraday change is large enough to transmit to gold.
Real yields are high-impact for gold when they change materially, but daily FRED data can be stale intraday.

low_or_no_weight_data.verdict: Useful macro context, but usually lower intraday weight unless the liquidity shift is large.

loopback_evaluation.scoring_feedback: Increase weight on the highest-ranked data types only when they aligned with the actual XAUUSD spot move; reduce weight on failed, stale, or non-transmitting inputs.
